title: Largest Perimeter Triangle
summary: Given an integer array, find the largest perimeter of a triangle with a non-zero area formed by any three elements.
statement: Given an integer array, find the largest perimeter of a triangle with a non-zero area formed by any three elements. If no such triangle can be formed, return 0.
constraints: Choose three positive lengths forming a nondegenerate triangle.
Return the largest possible perimeter, or zero.
hints: After descending sort, the first consecutive triple satisfying b+c>a has maximum perimeter.
Test consecutive triples from largest downward.
Return a+b+c at the first strict inequality, otherwise zero.
If b+c cannot beat a, replacing b or c by smaller later sides cannot help that a.
editorial: If b+c cannot beat a, replacing b or c by smaller later sides cannot help that a.

tests.explanation: Lengths 1,2,2 form a triangle with perimeter five.
No triple satisfies the strict triangle inequality.
